user.title: RalliSmart V2
user.description: Sign in with your RalliSmart app account. All homes on the account are added automatically; one integration entry manages every home.

license.title: License key
license.description: New installations require a License Key. [Click to open the activation page and get your key]({activate_url}). Each key works on one Home Assistant install only. Existing entries without a key retain pre-upgrade behavior in legacy compatibility mode; add a key in Options without deleting the integration.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the RalliSmart server
error.invalid_license: License key is invalid, expired, locked or already used on another install. Get a key at the license website.
error.invalid_license_server: Use a valid HTTPS server URL without credentials, query or fragment. HTTP is allowed only for loopback testing.
error.license_network: Cannot reach the license server. Check the URL / your connection.
error.license_key_invalid: License key not found. Check the key in your license dashboard; keys look like RDS-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
error.license_already_activated: This key is already bound to another Home Assistant install. Ask the license admin to reset the binding, or use a key for this install.
error.license_trial_used: The free trial was already used on this Home Assistant install. Buy a paid key to continue.
error.license_expired: This license has expired. Renew it or get a new key.
error.license_revoked: This license was revoked. Get a new key at the license website.
error.license_locked: This license is locked. Contact the license admin.
error.license_bad_request: The license server rejected the request. Check the integration version, then try again.
error.license_bad_response: The license server returned an invalid response. Try again later.
error.license_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

init.title: Configure license
init.description: Add or update your License Key. [Click to open the activation page and get your key]({activate_url}). Saving validates the license and reloads this entry; account, home and entity IDs stay unchanged. Legacy compatibility: existing entries without a key keep pre-upgrade behavior until a key is added. Once configured, server license results are enforced; clearing the key is not supported.
